title: Pricing — BitBoard
text:
Flat-rate plans with no usage billing. Free for individuals, $49 per seat for teams, and custom plans for enterprises.

Pricing
Choose the plan that fits you or your team. Not sure which?

Contact us
Questions
More questions?
Talk to us →
Which plan is right for me?
Individual is for working on your own. Teams adds a shared workspace, higher Ask limits, and centralized billing. Enterprise adds custom usage limits, administration, security, and support.
What are my payment options?
Plans support all major credit and debit cards.
Will I be charged for usage?
We do not currently bill for usage. All plans are a flat rate to keep your bills predictable.
